nofollow.description: When true, outbound write/card links for this platform include rel=nofollow (noopener is always kept).

noreferrer.description: When true, outbound write/card links for this platform include rel=noreferrer (noopener is always kept).

rel.description: Optional space-separated rel tokens for outbound links (e.g. "nofollow noreferrer"). Booleans nofollow/noreferrer override matching tokens when set. noopener is always applied.

theme.description: Color scheme. auto = follow host page theme (data-theme/class/color-scheme); light|dark force.

accolade_size.description: Optional max edge (px) for accolade logos in badge cards. Omit or 0 = fill the card’s free space (with padding). Positive values cap the logo. One global setting — no per-item size/width/height.

min_rating.description: Hide rated reviews (and rated testimonials) below this star rating. Omit to show all. Unrated reviews and accolades are unaffected. Hidden reviews are not counted, averaged or included in the JSON-LD. Overridden by data-min-rating / ?min_rating=.

hide.description: Review keys to hide, each <platform>-<platform_review_id> (the reviewer image file name convention). Hidden reviews stay in the data but are not shown, counted, averaged or included in the JSON-LD. data-hide / ?hide= (comma-separated) add to this list.

accolades_icon.description: Optional icon for the Awards filter pill: path relative to the data root or an absolute URL (SVG or image, shown at the platform icon size). Omit to use the built-in trophy icon.

testimonials_icon.description: Optional icon for the Testimonials filter pill: path relative to the data root or an absolute URL (SVG or image, shown at the platform icon size). Omit to use the built-in quote bubble icon.

languages.description: Translation catalogs as { lang, url }. lang is an ISO language tag (en, en-us, es, …); url is absolute or relative to the data root. Partial catalogs are fine; missing keys fall through to the widget's lang/en.json.

lang.description: ISO language tag for this catalog (matched against data-lang / browser / defaultLanguage).

url.description: Absolute URL or path relative to the data root for the translation JSON.

defaultLanguage.description: ISO code or primary subtag used when embed/page/browser do not match a languages[].lang entry. Matched against languages the same way; if nothing matches, the widget English catalog is used.

strings.description: Inline UI copy overrides (merged on top of the selected language file and the widget's lang/en.json).

title.description: Optional card headline for the summary card. Falls back to language/strings ai_summary (e.g. Highlights / Summary).

summary.description: Summary card shown first on the All tab. text + generated_at required; optional title overrides the language headline.

accolades.description: Optional award badge cards merged into the review track by date after the platform filter (and listed alone on the Awards tab when present). Each item sorts as YYYY-12-31 so it leads that year (newest first). When any accolades exist, at least one appears before the first review (newest award promoted if its year is older than the newest review). Each item needs year plus icon and/or freeform label (name is an alias). Optional url: when set the card is a link with a View award cue; when omitted the card is not clickable and has no footer cue. Logo fills the card free space by default; optional global max via display.accolade_size. Same optional nofollow/noreferrer/rel as platforms.

name.description: Optional freeform title alias for label. Prefer label over name when both are set.

label.description: Freeform title at the top of the card (with year). Prefer label over name when both are set.

year.description: Required. Sort key is YYYY-12-31 on the shared review timeline (leads that year when scrolling newest to oldest). Shown as the date under the title on the accolade card.

icon.description: Image URL or path relative to the data root. Shown as the badge in the middle of the card; when omitted, title + year still render (link cue only if url is set).

url.description: Optional. When set, the card is a link (View award cue). When omitted, the card is not clickable and has no footer link text.

rel.description: Optional space-separated rel tokens; same rules as platforms.*.rel.

testimonials.description: Optional testimonial cards merged into the review track by date (newest first) on the All tab, like accolades. Not tied to a review platform. When present, a Testimonials filter tab lists only these cards. Platform filters omit them. Each item needs title, text, and date; optional subtitle. Optional url (when set the card links with a footer cue; when omitted not clickable and no footer cue), link_text (footer cue when url is set; default Learn more / strings.view_testimonial), rating (1–5), reviewer_image. Optional source: if set, name is required; source.logo (when set) replaces the usual platform icon and is shown in the avatar position (reviewer image moves secondary). Same optional nofollow/noreferrer/rel as platforms.

title.description: Card title, shown like a reviewer name (not abbreviated). Freeform: a person, a team, a company.

subtitle.description: Optional second line under the title, less prominent (e.g. role and company, or "Team sponsor since 2023"). Not filled in from source.name.

reviewer_image.description: Optional avatar URL or path relative to the data root (initials of the title when omitted). Secondary when source.logo is set.

url.description: Optional outbound link for the card. When omitted, the card is not a link.

link_text.description: Optional footer link cue when url is set. Overrides strings.view_testimonial (default Learn more). Use when the destination is not the quote itself (e.g. company site).

source.description: Optional organization: logo shown in the avatar slot when set; name is used in the card's accessible label when there is no subtitle (it is not shown as a visible line). name required when source is present.

logo.description: URL or path relative to the data root. Shown in the avatar position when set; reviewer_image becomes secondary.

rel.description: Optional space-separated rel tokens; same rules as platforms.*.rel.
